description: These champions' basic attacks always bypass Wind Wall, Unbreakable, and Blade Whirl — their autos aren't classified as projectiles despite being ranged.
Aphelios bypasses all three while using Severum. Fiddlesticks, Kayle (post-Arisen), and Samira herself bypass all three specifically while attacking from melee range.

Unbreakable's damage reduction applies to any damage from its facing direction, not just true projectiles — including instant-cast direction abilities like Xerath Q or Lux R, which Wind Wall doesn't touch at all.

If Braum also has an item spell shield (Banshee's, Edge of Night), a single blockable spell consumes both the spell shield and Unbreakable's one-time full-negate charge at once, wasting one of the two.
An enemy spell shield blocks only one of Blade Whirl's two slashes, not both.
